messages:
jasmin: hey team, day 1 snag. I ran the dotfiles bootstrap but my shell is fish and node/pnpm + python from asdf aren't available. `pnpm` says command not found and `python3.10` isn't found either. I see the dotfiles created ~/.zshrc symlink — did I do something wrong or should I switch shells?

oliver: welcome Jasmin! :wave: The bootstrap targets zsh by default. If you prefer fish there are a couple of extra steps. What does `echo $SHELL` show?

jasmin: `/usr/local/bin/fish`. I tried adding `export PATH="$HOME/.asdf/bin:$PATH"` to config.fish but fish doesn't like `export`.

sam: right — fish uses `set` not `export`. For fish add near the top of `~/.config/fish/config.fish`: ``set -x PATH $HOME/.asdf/bin $PATH`` then source the asdf script: ``source (brew --prefix asdf)/libexec/asdf.fish`` (if that file exists) or fallback to ``source (brew --prefix asdf)/libexec/asdf.sh`` which works for interactive shims. Also add direnv hook for fish: ``status --is-login; and eval (direnv hook fish)`` and run `direnv allow` in repo.

jasmin: thanks. `brew --prefix asdf` -> /opt/homebrew/opt/asdf. I added the `set -x` line and the `source` line, restarted fish, but `asdf list` is empty. `asdf plugin-list` shows `python nodejs` though.

oliver: plugins present but runtimes not installed. Try `asdf install python 3.10.12` and `asdf install nodejs 18.17.0`. If python build fails on macOS you'll need openssl/readline libs: ``brew install openssl readline xz zlib`` and then temporary env for build: ``set -x LDFLAGS -L(brew --prefix openssl)/lib`` and ``set -x CPPFLAGS -I(brew --prefix openssl)/include`` in fish before running `asdf install`.

jasmin: `asdf install python 3.10.12` failed earlier with a missing openssl header. Installing the brew deps now. Also I noticed `npm config get prefix` -> /usr/local which required sudo previously. I want pnpm in my home dir. What's the fish-friendly npm prefix change?

sam: do this in fish: ``mkdir -p $HOME/.npm-global; npm config set prefix "$HOME/.npm-global"`` then add to config.fish: ``set -x NPM_PACKAGES $HOME/.npm-global; set -x PATH $NPM_PACKAGES/bin $PATH``. Then `npm i -g pnpm` should put pnpm under `~/.npm-global/bin`.

jasmin: reinstalled pnpm and `command -v pnpm` -> /Users/jasmin/.npm-global/bin/pnpm. python build finished after I set LDFLAGS/CPPFLAGS. `asdf global python 3.10.12` and `python3.10 --version` -> Python 3.10.12.

oliver: great. One tiny note: if your machine somehow has both /usr/local and /opt/homebrew (intel vs arm installs), prefer using `$(brew --prefix ...)` or `(brew --prefix ...)` in fish so the paths resolve dynamically. We'll update the dotfiles README to call out fish users.

eng-oncall-bot: Created ticket INF-789: "onboarding: add fish shell section to dotfiles bootstrap + npm prefix examples" assigned to @sam.

jasmin: awesome, thanks for the quick help and the ticket. I'll open a small PR to mention fish and the `set -x` examples for npm and asdf in the dotfiles README.
